address: Europa and Jenner House, Victory Park, Medway City Estate, Rochester, ME2 4ER
description: Canoports UK Limited is a UK aluminium products manufacturer operating three brand divisions: AliDeck (fire-rated balcony and decking systems for high-rise remediation and new build), The Milwood Group (canopy and veranda systems sold through a national trade partner network), and Lurano (direct-to-consumer premium outdoor living, launched 2026). All operations run from a 75,000 sq ft manufacturing site in Rochester with a secondary 8,000 sq ft site in Hinckley. In-house QualiCoat-accredited powder coating line. FY25 revenue £18.4m, adjusted EBITDA £2.99m. Owner-founder (Mark Wood) planning succession-led exit to retirement. Successor CEO (Richard) identified internally, 15-year tenure. Broker Benchmark International (Emma Windle, Jack Giles). Indicative offer submitted at £10.9m (6x three-year average) on 2 June 2026; counter received 24 June asking £17-20m; awaiting revised position ahead of 10 July deadline.
